conviction_note: Hiab's first quarter with Labrie consolidated, with new orders, margin, cash and net-debt lines, so the move should be large (own observed print reactions -13.4, +9.2, +11.2 over the last four). The sign is close to a coin: the order-side risks (SEB 6% below consensus on orders, Palfinger's 9M EBIT -8%, Terex's lower refuse-truck shipments) are mostly in a stock already down 18% from its 22 Sep high on two downgrades. Against them sit a company order book up 10% and two straight beats. Hence p_up 47 on a 7.5 abs move, which scales to -0.45. That is close to the findings' own sum of -0.4 and was not fitted to it.

new_in_release.expect: Q3 orders and order book, the line SEB flagged at 6% below consensus. Headline YoY will be inflated by Labrie, so the organic figure decides it. Lean slightly negative.
Q3 sales vs a EUR 495m bar (Yahoo, 4 analysts, 468-515) and comparable operating margin, the first quarter with Labrie and its PPA. Direction unknown; SEB has EBIT in line.
FY above 14.5% most likely reiterated. A specification up or down cannot be excluded in the first post-acquisition quarter. Unknown sign.

Net debt jumps from net cash EUR 155m to roughly 2x EBITDA on Labrie. Q2 operating cash flow was weak at EUR 25m (56m a year earlier) on working capital, so cash conversion is a live risk. Unknown, slight negative risk.
Labrie quarterly contribution and margin, and commentary on US refuse-vehicle demand. Unknown.

findings.finding: Palfinger, the closest loader-crane peer, issued an ad hoc on 30 Sep 2026 guiding 9M 2026 EBIT to about EUR 120m against EUR 130.7m (about -8%). Press coverage attributes the weakness to the Middle East war hitting demand including service, US tariffs not fully passed on, and weak US and German core markets.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Hiab fell 13.4% on 2025-10-24 when Q3 2025 profitability was hit by lower US sales. When the quarter beat (Q1 and Q2 2026) it rose 9.2% and 11.2%.
findings.original_quote: Der Krieg im Nahen Osten bremste die Nachfrage und traf auch das margenstarke Servicegeschäft. Dazu kamen US-Zölle, die Palfinger nicht voll weitergeben kann, und schwache Kernmärkte in den USA und Deutschland. (topagrar, 2026-10-22: 'The Middle East war slowed demand and also hit the high-margin service business; plus US tariffs Palfinger cannot fully pass on, and weak core markets in the US and Germany.')
findings.why_not_priced: Hiab moved only -0.77% on 30 Sep while Palfinger fell 9.7%, so the peer read-through did not visibly transmit that day. If it had been priced as a Hiab Q3 miss, consensus revenue would have come down from EUR 495m and the order bar would have been cut, and SEB still has EBIT in line. Partly priced through the general -8.3% 20-day de-rating. This is a peer proxy, not a Hiab number, and Hiab's Q2 comparable operating profit rose 1% while Palfinger's H1 EBIT fell 7%, so the two have diverged.
findings.independence: Context is secondary press (https://www.topagrar.com/technik/news/palfinger-durch-weltweite-krisen-unter-druck-ladebuhnen-sparte-wird-verkauft-20030053.html, 2026-10-22, citing Wallstreet Online). The DNB Carnegie macro note (fuel prices, rates) points the same way from a different source.

findings.finding: SEB downgraded Hiab to hold (TP 67 to 65) on 24 Sep 2026. It sits 6% below consensus on Q3 order intake and in line on adjusted EBIT, and expects lower order intake and a smaller sales contribution from Labrie over the next twelve months, cutting 2027-28 EBIT 3-4%.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Orders drove the last reactions: Q2 2026 orders +16% came with +11.2% on the day (alongside a guide raise); Q3 2025 orders -3% came with -13.4%.
findings.original_quote: SEB räknar med lägre orderingång och ett mindre försäljningsbidrag från förvärvade Labrie de kommande tolv månaderna. ... Inför tredje kvartalet ligger SEB 6 procent under konsensus för orderingången och i linje med konsensus för justerat ebit. ('SEB expects lower order intake and a smaller sales contribution from the acquired Labrie over the coming twelve months ... Ahead of Q3 SEB is 6 percent below consensus on order intake and in line with consensus on adjusted EBIT.')
findings.why_not_priced: Largely priced: Hiab fell 8.67% on 24 Sep on 170k shares against a roughly 60-90k norm. The residual is that one broker's below-consensus order number is not the consensus, so a miss on orders against the published bar is still possible. If it were fully priced, consensus order estimates would have converged on SEB's.
findings.independence: Terex's Q2 refuse-vehicle commentary (https://s203.q4cdn.com/676879669/files/doc_news/Terex-Reports-Second-Quarter-2026-Results-2026.pdf) points the same way on Labrie. Inderes forum post 483 (https://forum.inderes.com/t/cargotec-salkkuun/101/483, 2026-09-24) records the same note.

findings.finding: DNB Carnegie downgraded Hiab to hold (TP 60) on 8 Oct 2026, arguing that higher fuel prices and rising interest rates will dampen consumption growth and construction activity and delay Hiab's recovery after sales declines of 8% in 2024 and 6% in 2025.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Guidance changes moved the stock most: +11.2% on the 22 Jul 2026 raise to above 14.5%, and +9.2% on 24 Apr 2026 when it was raised to above 13.5%.
findings.original_quote: Analytikern Tom Skogman pekar på högre bränslepriser och stigande räntor, som väntas dämpa konsumtionstillväxten och byggaktiviteten. Därmed riskerar Hiabs återhämtning att försenas ('The analyst points to higher fuel prices and rising rates, expected to dampen consumption growth and construction activity, so Hiab's recovery risks being delayed').
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced: the stock fell up to 5.1% that day and 3.4% the next. This is macro-to-company transmission with no company or counterparty statement behind it, so it is kept small. The residual is whether management's outlook language turns more cautious on H2/2027.
findings.independence: The Palfinger ad hoc (https://www.ad-hoc-news.de/boerse/news/ad-hoc-mitteilungen/palfinger-ag-at0000758305/70203371) is the only peer evidence of the demand effect.

findings.finding: Terex reported Q2 2026 Environmental Solutions sales up 5.9% only because utilities offset lower refuse collection vehicle shipments, with under-absorption from lower RCV volume. RCVs are the product of Hiab's newly consolidated Labrie, the line SEB says will contribute less.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No history: Q3 2026 is Labrie's first consolidated quarter.
findings.why_not_priced: It came out after Hiab's 22 Jul guide was set, but analysts modelling Labrie have had it since July, and the stock has since de-rated. This is a competitor proxy, and Labrie (Canada-based, long backlog) is about a fifth of Q3 group sales, so the net effect on the group is small. If it were priced, the revenue bar range would sit below EUR 468m.
findings.independence: The SEB note (https://www.borsvarlden.com/artiklar/seb-sanker-hiab-till-behall-riktkurs-65-euro) independently expects a smaller Labrie contribution.

findings.finding: Hiab entered Q3 with an order book of EUR 589m, up 10% since 31 Dec 2025, after Q2 orders of +16% (highest in four years) and a positive book-to-bill in all geographies for a second quarter. That supports Q3 deliveries against a bar that SEB, the most bearish broker cited, still has in line on EBIT.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The last two quarters beat EPS consensus by +23% and +11% (Yahoo earningsHistory) and the stock rose 9.2% and 11.2% on the day.
findings.why_not_priced: This is a public company-level number, so it is inside what was guided and kept small. Its weight is that it is a primary document against peer proxies and broker opinions that have driven an 18% fall from 65.45 (22 Sep) to 53.4. If the market were pricing the order book, the stock would not trade at a 22% discount to the EUR 68.2 mean target (Yahoo financialData, 5 analysts).
findings.independence: Q1 report: order book 562 against 534 at Dec 2025 (https://view.news.eu.nasdaq.com/view?id=b6aa1438ef2a346f5010f1620caa2852d&lang=en&src=listed). The 7 May 2026 EUR 37m MOFFETT US order (https://view.news.eu.nasdaq.com/view?id=b2fdf57fdd9f83ca932f34de52ab6771a&lang=en&src=listed) sits partly in that backlog.

findings.finding: The stock has de-rated about 18% since 22 Sep (65.45 to 53.4) on two downgrades (SEB 24 Sep, DNB Carnegie 8 Oct), a Danske target cut and the peer warning, while OP upgraded to buy and the Yahoo 5-analyst mean target is EUR 68.2. The bar going into the print is lower than it was when the guide was raised.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: After the -13.4% Q3 2025 print the stock sat at 44.6 and then rallied through two beats. The pre-print run-ups to those beats are not measured here.
findings.why_not_priced: This is the price itself, so it is a statement about what is priced rather than an unpriced fact. Its value is that the negative findings above already sit in it. With no short anchor (register truncated) the de-rating is long-holder selling, which leaves less forced supply on an in-line print. This is inference and is kept small.

baseline_tension: The peer and broker evidence leans negative while the baseline lean is mildly positive (+0.415, run-up only). That evidence is the cause of the -8.3% 20-day run-up, so it largely agrees with the price, and that is why p_up sits only slightly below 50.
language_note: Two broker notes reached the hunt only through Swedish-language Finwire copy (Börsvärlden, Placera): SEB's Q3 orders at 6% below consensus with EBIT in line, and DNB Carnegie's fuel-price and interest-rate reasoning. English sources carried only the headline rating changes.

The Finnish Inderes forum dated the SEB downgrade to the -8.7% day of 24 Sep and recorded the IR team's investor-meeting theme on Labrie services (post 482, 2026-09-14). Finnish press (Kauppalehti, Inderes) carried no Q3 preview or consensus, and the issuer's Finnish releases match the English ones.

German-language sources (the topagrar summary of Wallstreet Online) carried Palfinger's demand drivers (Middle East war, US tariffs, weak US and Germany). The English ad hoc carries only the EBIT figure and the Russia write-down.
lessons_applied: Macro-to-company transmission is a hypothesis: the DNB Carnegie fuel and rates finding cut from -0.3 to -0.2.
A narrow proxy loses to a company-level number: the Palfinger peer finding cut from -0.8 to -0.6 and the Terex RCV proxy from -0.4 to -0.3, while Hiab's own order-book finding rose from +0.5 to +0.6.
A zero short on a register that read is the truncation floor (anchor_covered false): the positioning finding and positioning_check no longer cite 'no disclosed short' as evidence.

Size on what is new, and understatement is the systematic error: abs_move_pct raised from 7.0 to 7.5, because this is the first Labrie quarter and Hiab's observed print reactions (-13.4, +9.2, +11.2) exceed the baseline's 2.93 proxy. p_up moved from 46 to 47 as the proxy weight fell.
Cash can outweigh the guide: the cash_flow line was added to new_in_release (Q2 operating cash flow EUR 25m against 56m, net debt going to about 2x).
